LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 6.3.1 PHRASAL QUANTIFIERS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.3: Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Phrasal Quantifiers
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Phrasal Quantifiers, part of Strand 6 in Grade 6 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: How do we tell countable nouns from uncountable ones? 2. Which words are used to show the amount of something?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. work with peers to view a video or listen to an audio text on work ethics featuring phrasal quantifiers and identify them,

2. make sentences using phrasal quantifiers such as a lot of..., a pinch of... plenty of..., a number of, a crate of ...,

3. create charts and posters using phrasal quantifiers and share them on the school notice board or social media,

4. form sentences from a substitution table. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. work with peers to view a video or listen to an audio text on work ethics featuring phrasal quantifiers and identify them,
2. make sentences using phrasal quantifiers such as a lot of..., a pinch of... plenty of..., a number of, a crate of ...,
3. create charts and posters using phrasal quantifiers and share them on the school notice board or social media,
4. form sentences from a substitution table. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Phrasal Quantifiers together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication: The learner’s ability for self-expression is developed through creating posters using phrasal

quantifiers.

• Digital Literacy: The learner’s ability to manipulate technology for learning is improved as they view videos

featuring phrasal quantifiers or display charts on social media.

Values:
Integrity: This is inculcated in the learner as they interact with information on choosing to do the right thing by

reading material/texts on work ethics.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Career exploration: The learner’s knowledge on careers is enhanced as they interact with information on the theme

when working with peers to view a video or listen to an audio text on work ethics featuring phrasal quantifiers.

Link to other Learning Areas:
